subject: Rename macros in valkey-cli.c and redis_strlcpy to valkey (#284)
reason: The change is a pure identifier rename: redis_strlcpy becomes valkey_strlcpy in its definition, declaration and every call site, and valkey-cli.c's REDIS_CLI_* macros become CLI_* while keeping the same values — the environment variable names (REDISCLI_AUTH, REDISCLI_HISTFILE, REDISCLI_RCFILE, REDISCLI_CLUSTER_YES) and the keepalive/pipe-timeout constants are byte-for-byte unchanged, and the fmacros.h hunk only edits a deprecation-warning string. No runtime behavior, reply, file format, protocol or tool output changes; a missed rename would fail compilation, which the build under test already
